n: Code.org CS Discoveries Unit 6 Physical Computing interactive artwork
t: A Code.org lesson where students build interactive artwork with Circuit Playground sensors.
steps: Find the unit on Code.org and check the lesson number for your course year.
Ask IT to install the Maker Toolkit on a computer.
Buy Circuit Playground boards and USB cables.
Gather craft materials for the artwork.
Decide whether students will use accounts.
Test one board and one sensor before class.
